name: desire for territory
description: Wanting to reserve physical or social assets for yourself or important others.

variations.name: defending home territory
variations.description: To have enough resources to safely survive, many animals mark their terrory and are willing to fight to defend it.

variations.name: acquire new territory
variations.description: Those without enough of their own resources may attack others to transfer territory or social assets.

commentaries.quote: Social assets can be territory as well, like being the sales rep for an important client or a top media influencer in a lucrative category. Of course 'attacking' and 'defending' may look different for social assets than for physical assets.
Being told to pick up sticks in your parent's yard feels a lot different than picking up sticks in your own yard.

conditions: Self wants to defend or acquire a particular physical or social territory.
Self wants to defend or acquire a particular physical territory.
